acceptanceCriteria: the dispute is settled by an owner-accepted spec amendment or decision, and any resulting fix lands with a regression test
body: Filed 2026-09-25 from the pre-1.0 expert panel review, main report §4 Disputed findings (scratchpad review/out/panel-report.md). Both verifiers confirmed the code facts; they split on whether the behaviour is a defect or an accepted documented choice. Owner instruction 2026-09-25: known issues are addressed before the next release. Settle the split (spec amendment or fix) as the finding's own 'Settles it' text says, then fix or record the accepted choice. Finding text: Second consumer scope (proof-soundness high, wire-contract high; both 1/2). Agreed: `interop/cem01-go` reads cem/0.1 only (`cem.go:24,584`, `ci.go:205` exit 4), the default producer emits cem/0.2, all 128 sealed dogfood CEMs are cem/0.2, no reader exists for OCM or frontier, and `make interop-gate` (`Makefile:129`) runs only that module's tests. Split: the confirming verifiers read Core item 2 (1.0 spec:43-45, :161) as claiming the in-repo second consumer covers the whole frozen wire; the refuting verifiers point to spec:153-161, PRS-V1-007, `docs/CEM-CI.md:142` and `examples/cem/README.md:8` as already scoping it to cem/0.1 and forbidding an interoperability claim. Settles it: an owner edit to Core item 2 and the V1-0013 acceptance wording that says "second consumer covers cem/0.1 only; cem/0.2, OCM and frontier are single-implementation at 1.0", or a cem/0.2 clean-room consumer wired into `interop-gate`. The README wording (section 3, admission) is confirmed regardless.

completion.reason: Settled: the owner accepted this finding's settlement on 2026-10-06, recorded as decision 0436 (docs/decisions/0436-panel-disputed-findings-settlement-accepted-2026-10-06.md at 07452b07fd8cfd4fc622ad90c673a323b3d6d495, PR beamfall/corvint#633; evidence digest is that file's sha256). The settlement landed on main in commit 9cc47ec5, with the regression tests the decision table names (or a documentation-only scope change). No suite was rerun for this closure.
